name: wp-dev-ci-toolchain
description: Pinned semantic-release toolchain baked into the wp-dev-ci image. Not published; consumed only via `npm ci` during the image build.

scripts.test:pipeline:build-and-push: act workflow_dispatch -j build-and-push --container-architecture linux/amd64 -P ubuntu-latest=catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest -s DOCKERHUB_USERNAME=local-dry-run -s DOCKERHUB_TOKEN=local-dry-run
